je_pmr_dam_columbia_river_survey = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed_any
		p:x3F0EE7.state.owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				top_overlord = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
			}
			else = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop  top_overlord ?= { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop } } }
			set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_family  value = scope:pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 36
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3F0EE7 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
								any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
								any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_block
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

			}
		}

	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_upper_ob_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_upper_ob_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_surveyed_any
		p:x875B76.state.owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				top_overlord = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
			}
			else = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop  top_overlord ?= { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop } } }
			set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_upper_ob_family  value = scope:pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_upper_ob_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 18
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x875B76 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
								any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
								any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_block

	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_surveyed_any
		p:x5F00C0.state.owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				top_overlord = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
			}
			else = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop  top_overlord ?= { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop } } }
			set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_family  value = scope:pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 18
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x5F00C0 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
								any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
								any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_months

		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_dam_first_cataract_survey = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_first_cataract_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_first_cataract_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_surveyed_any
		p:xC48A06.state.owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				top_overlord = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
			}
			else = { save_scope_as = pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop  top_overlord ?= { this = scope:pmr_dam_famtop } } }
			set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_first_cataract_family  value = scope:pmr_dam_famtop }
		}
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_first_cataract_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 18
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_months }
			NOT = {
				p:xC48A06 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
								any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
								any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_block
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_first_cataract_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}
